Usage: rhythm-sightread init [ci] [--force]

Without ci, writes .sightread/config.yaml in this folder with every setting
explained, the ecosystems found here and fail_on high. With ci, writes
.github/workflows/sightread.yml in the repository root: the Sightread Action
reviews lockfile changes on pull requests and everything once a week. Neither
replaces an existing file without --force.

Flags:
  --comment           ci: keep one pull request comment with the result;
                      --comment=false turns it off (default true)
  --fail-on <level>   ci: fail the job on findings at or above this level, or
                      none (default high)
  --force             replace an existing file
  --sarif             ci: also upload findings to GitHub code scanning

Examples:
  rhythm-sightread init
  rhythm-sightread init ci
  rhythm-sightread init ci --fail-on critical --sarif
